subject: Endgame invoicing prep and deferred PO triage
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Endgame invoicing prep and deferred PO triage

Team —

Quick sync: Finance asked for a tight reconciliation of bookings we expect to recognize in November/December that are gated by outstanding POs or PO amendments. We need a single source of truth for the 11/30 recognition cutoff so revenue ops can finalize the November forecast.

Ask: please update the deferred_pos_tracker.csv (attached) with the following by EOD 11/11:
- PO expected date (procurement commit)
- whether partial invoicing is allowed per account (yes/no)
- legal hold or contract amendment required (Y/N + short reason)
- internal owner for follow-up

Ben — can you dump the latest PO statuses from the pipeline snapshot and call out any POs >$100k that are at risk for the month?
Laura — we may need a staged-invoice template if Acme will accept partials; can you prep a draft we can reuse?
Vivek — if any Dedicated accounts need SLA exceptions to invoice early, flag them here.

I want to run a 30-minute commit review on 11/18 10:00 PT (calendar invite pending). If we have the tracker updated by 11/11 we can do a preflight on 11/16.

Thanks — short and sharp on this one.

Monica Patel
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: deferred_pos_tracker.csv (spreadsheet stub)

- Nimbus Labs: PO in legal review (possible amendment for term).
- Meridian AI: procurement said they can accept partial invoice for 40% milestone; needs staged SOW.

From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@acme.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tbaker@acme.com>, Acme Corp procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Endgame invoicing prep and deferred PO triage

Thanks for the notes — Sophie from Acme finance here.

We expect Procurement to issue the formal PO for the new Dedicated seats by 2027-11-20. Our policy is that AP will not accept invoices without a PO on file, so we won’t be able to accept an invoice earlier than that date. If Redwood can provide a staged invoice tied to the delivery milestone (e.g., 40% on provisioning, 60% on go-live) we can accept partial invoices once the PO is issued.

A couple of clarifications:
- Can you confirm the exact legal entity on the quote? Our AP team is strict about entity match.
- If there are any one-off credits we agreed on, those need to be reflected on the invoice header.

I can loop in our procurement lead (procurement@acme.com) directly if that helps accelerate.

Regards,
Sophie Lang
Senior Finance Manager, Acme Corp

Summary:
- Acme PO expected 11/20; AP requires PO before accepting invoices.
- Meridian AI can accept staged invoices; Nimbus needs a legal amendment.
- Tracker is updated with owners and expected dates (see linked drive).

Action items (owners, due):
1) Monica/Ben — confirm legal entity and add any negotiated credits to the invoice header (due 11/15).
2) Laura — draft one-paragraph amendment for Nimbus and a generic partial-invoice clause we can reuse (due 11/16).
3) Ben — validate POs >$100k for November and flag any late procurement reps (due 11/15).
4) Vivek — list any Dedicated accounts needing SLA exception for early invoicing (due 11/15).

Commit review: 11/18 10:00 PT (30 min). Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-invoice-commit-review
Preflight: 11/16 09:00 PT (15 min) — internal only.

If you cannot meet these dates, reply with constraints immediately. I will escalate to Finance on 11/16 if the tracker is not complete.
